page_title: CEL 1-0 OSA | Celta Vigo v Osasuna 21/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' Osasuna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
87' Abel Bretones comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
87' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Munoz (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch so that Jon Moncayola can be given a rest.
86' Claudio Giraldez decides to make a substitution. Williot Swedberg will be replaced by Iker Losada (Celta Vigo).
86' Today's match ends for Oscar Mingueza who will be replaced by Jailson (Celta Vigo).
85' Osasuna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.
82' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
80' Here is a change. Moi Gomez is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Kike Barja (Osasuna).
80' Substitution. Raul Garcia (Osasuna) replaces Bryan Zaragoza.
80' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies well wide of the right post.
78' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Borja Iglesias as he is replaced by Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo).
78' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Hugo Sotelo and he is replaced by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo).
76' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
73' It's time for a substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) comes on in place of Alejandro Catena.
71' The Celta Vigo players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
69' 1 - 0 Goal! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Sergio Herrera into the bottom left corner.
69' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is going to take the penalty!
68' Referee Jose Sanchez sees the trip by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Celta Vigo are awarded a penalty kick!
68' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
65' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Fernando Lopez.
64' Neat passing move from Osasuna in order to create new attacking opportunities.
63' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) commits a foul and Jose Sanchez immediately signals a free kick.
62' The linesman signals that Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
61' A precise low pass is received by Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
58' Celta Vigo have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

57' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the bottom right corner from a promising distance, but Sergio Herrera denies him.
56' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went a whisker over the bar.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo).
54' Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
52' None of the Celta Vigo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
52' Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Sergio Herrera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
49' Some great controlled play and passing from Celta Vigo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' The attendance for today's match is 22005.
46' Celta Vigo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
38' What was Fernando Lopez (Celta Vigo) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
36' Celta Vigo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' A cross from Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
31' Osasuna are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
29' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
25' Fine attempt! Bryan Zaragoza (Osasuna) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
23' Osasuna hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
22' Jose Sanchez blows his whistle after Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
20' That was close by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
16' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
15' Osasuna win a corner.
14' Poor challenge! Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) is penalised for tripping and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle.
13' 34:66 – the latest ball possession ratio.
11' Sergio Carreira (Celta Vigo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Ruben Pena (Osasuna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
6' What a chance that is! Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
5' Osasuna keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Celta Vigo comes to nothing.
3' Celta Vigo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Ante Budimir (Osasuna), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.
2' Osasuna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

2' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee signals a corner kick to Osasuna.
1' Some patient build-up play from Osasuna as they look to unlock the defence.
1' The first half has just begun.
